page.title: Rails
page.purpose: Show which payment mechanisms are available, which instruments exist, and what each is scoped to. An operator uses this page to answer whether a spend could physically happen.

priorities.statement: Which rails are usable right now, and which are refusing, is readable at a glance
Each instrument's scope is shown so an over-broad instrument is visible
Inbound metering status is shown alongside outbound, since both share the rail
No credential material appears anywhere on this page
A rail refusing because a dependency is down is distinguishable from one not configured

states.description: Rails are registered and reporting status.
Only the manual rail is configured; the page frames this as a valid starting state, not a gap.
Some rails report status and others are unreachable.
Rail status could not be fetched.
The facilitator is unreachable; inbound metering reports unavailable rather than serving unpaid.
Displayed data is older than its refresh interval and states its age.

claims.statement: No credential material — card number, key, or secret — appears in any state of this page.
Each instrument displays the mandate scope it is bound to.
A rail that is not configured is distinguishable from one that is configured and refusing.
Inbound metering status appears alongside outbound rail status.
